items.title: A scheme is excellent exactly when it is quasi-excellent and universally catenary
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a scheme is excellent exactly when it is quasi-excellent and universally catenary (statement lines 3439-3446). The counted proof is short and complete: one direction follows from the corresponding implications for rings together with the locality of universal catenarity, and the other direction chooses at each point an affine neighbourhood with quasi-excellent coordinate ring, observes that this ring is universally catenary by the same locality statement, and concludes excellence (proof lines 3448-3459). It is H2: both directions are carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the locality statement for universal catenarity.
